description: Find stations, airports, bus terminals, ports, sightseeing spots and sights in Japan by name (Japanese, English, Chinese or Korean; partial match). Returns place IDs to use with get_place and find_routes, coordinates, and the URL of each place's page. Returns results[]: type (place or sight), id, kind, name, names (five languages), lat, lng, area, page (URL for people), api (URL of the details), routeEndpoint (pass it to find_routes as from or to).

lang.description: Language of names and texts in the response. Long descriptions exist in Japanese and English only; other languages fall back to English.

q.description: Name or part of a name, up to 60 characters.

name: search_places
title: Search places by name
